description: This file contains utility functions and constants for handling Teams attachments, including URL validation, image extraction, SSRF protection, and safe HTTP fetch with redirect validation.

methods.name: isRecord
methods.description: Checks if a value is a non-array object.

methods.name: resolveRequestUrl
methods.description: Resolves various input types to a URL string.

methods.name: normalizeContentType
methods.description: Trims and normalizes a content type string.

methods.name: inferPlaceholder
methods.description: Infers a placeholder string based on content type and filename.

methods.name: isLikelyImageAttachment
methods.description: Determines if a Teams attachment is likely an image based on content type and filename.

methods.name: isDownloadableAttachment
methods.description: Checks if an attachment can be downloaded, based on content type and URL.

methods.name: extractHtmlFromAttachment
methods.description: Extracts HTML content from a Teams attachment if content type is HTML.

methods.name: extractInlineImageCandidates
methods.description: Extracts inline image candidates from attachments, respecting size limits.

methods.name: safeHostForUrl
methods.description: Returns the hostname in lowercase, or 'invalid-url' if invalid.

methods.name: resolveAllowedHosts
methods.description: Normalizes and returns the list of allowed hostnames for media.

methods.name: resolveAuthAllowedHosts
methods.description: Normalizes and returns the list of allowed hostnames for authorization.

methods.name: resolveAttachmentFetchPolicy
methods.description: Builds fetch policy object with allowed hosts.

methods.name: isUrlAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a URL's hostname is in the allowlist.

methods.name: applyAuthorizationHeaderForUrl
methods.description: Sets or deletes the Authorization header based on URL allowlist and token.

methods.name: resolveMediaSsrfPolicy
methods.description: Creates an SSRF policy from hostname allowlist.

methods.name: isPrivateOrReservedIP
methods.description: Checks if an IP address is private or reserved.

methods.name: resolveAndValidateIP
methods.description: Resolves hostname to IP and rejects private/reserved IPs.

methods.name: safeFetch
methods.description: Performs a fetch with redirect validation and anti-SSRF checks.

methods.name: safeFetchWithPolicy
methods.description: Performs a fetch using a specified attachment fetch policy.
